chunks: Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn 'Isa al-'Ubaydi, from al-Husayn ibn 'Ubayd, who said:

I wrote to al-Sadiq عليه السلام: Did Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام perform ghusl when he washed the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله at the time of his death? He said: “The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله was pure and purified, but Amir al-Mu'minin 'Ali ibn Abi Talib عليه السلام did that, and the sunnah (prophetic tradition) came to be established by it.”

By the praise of Allah and His grace, the first part of the book Tahdhib al-Ahkam has been completed, and we ask Allah, Exalted is He, for success in completing the remaining parts. By the praise of Allah, the commentary on the first part of Tahdhib al-Ahkam was completed by the hand of the one who confesses his disobedience, Hasan al-Musawi al-Khurasani.

key_terms.السُّنَّةُ: the established prophetic tradition and normative practice
key_terms.تَهْذِيبِ الْأَحْكَامِ: the title of the hadith compilation Tahdhib al-Ahkam

ai.seo_question: Did Imam 'Ali عليه السلام perform ghusl after washing the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, and does that establish a sunnah (prophetic tradition)?
ai.summary: This report asks whether Imam 'Ali عليه السلام performed ghusl after washing the body of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام replies that the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم was inherently pure, yet Imam 'Ali عليه السلام performed ghusl, and this became an established sunnah (prophetic tradition), indicating a jurisprudential basis for the practice.
